IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Parks, Fish & Wildlife (originally sponsored by Senators Hargrove and Jacobsen)

Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the personal use shellfish license fee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing a surcharge on the personal useshellfish license fee to fund the Olympic region harmful algal bloomprogram; adding a new section to chapter 77.32 RCW; and creating newsections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that natural, commonlyoccurring harmful algal blooms on the Washington coast cause thetemporary contamination of shellfish and require the temporarycessation of recreational and commercial shellfishing activities. Thelegislature further finds it is in the interest of state agencies,coastal native tribes, marine resourcebased businesses, and localcommunities to develop and implement a monitoring program to predictthe occurrence of these harmful algal blooms.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to the fees authorized in this chapter, the departmentshall include a surcharge to fund monitoring by the Olympic regionharmful algal bloom program of the Olympic natural resources center at p. 1 SSB 5215the University of Washington. A surcharge of one dollar applies to theresident and nonresident shellfish and seaweed licenses as authorizedby RCW 77.32.520(2) (a) and (b). Amounts collected from this surchargeshall be deposited in the general fund-local account managed by theUniversity of Washington. The University of Washington shall transfer from the generalfund--local account to the general fund amounts collected from thesurcharge that exceed one hundred fifty thousand dollars per year.
The surcharge imposed in this act shall beimplemented in the department of fish and wildlife's license feestructure for the license year beginning April 1, 2004.
